title: fritillaria messanensis var. hispanica
intro: Fritillaria messanensis var. hispanica, commonly known as the Spanish snipe's fritillary or Spanish imperial fritillary, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria messanensis var. hispanica include anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities, which contribute to its use in treating infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
